claim_borrower.reason: the borrower claims the collateral back after repaying; measured at the first build, plus 10%

claim_lender.reason: the lender claims a repaid loan into the vault; measured at the first build, plus 10%

close_default_time_based.reason: a liquid loan past grace defaulted, its collateral sold to the lender; measured at the first build, plus 10%; raised 2026-11-22 when prices moved from mocks onto the real guard path (#3915): each price read now runs the guard's own code

close_fallback_entry.reason: a default whose every swap route fails, entering the in-kind fallback; measured at the first build, plus 10%; raised 2026-11-22 when prices moved from mocks onto the real guard path (#3915): each price read now runs the guard's own code

close_liquidation_hf.reason: a loan below health factor 1 liquidated by a third party through the swap route; measured at the first build, plus 10%; raised 2026-11-22 when prices moved from mocks onto the real guard path (#3915): each price read now runs the guard's own code

collateral_add.reason: collateral added to an open loan by its borrower; measured at the first build, plus 10%; raised 2026-11-22 when prices moved from mocks onto the real guard path (#3915): each price read now runs the guard's own code

collateral_withdraw_surplus.reason: surplus collateral withdrawn from an open loan; measured at the first build, plus 10%; raised 2026-11-22 when prices moved from mocks onto the real guard path (#3915): each price read now runs the guard's own code

exit_preclose.reason: the borrower closes a loan early; measured at the first build, plus 10%

exit_sale_direct.reason: the lender sells the loan into a standing lender offer in one transaction; measured at the first build, plus 10%; raised 2026-11-22 when prices moved from mocks onto the real guard path (#3915): each price read now runs the guard's own code

exit_sale_listing.reason: the lender lists the loan for sale with a sale offer; measured at the first build, plus 10%

exit_sale_listing_accept.reason: a buyer accepts a listed loan sale and the sale settles in the same transaction; measured at the first build, plus 10%

instant_borrow_1.reason: instant borrow taking 1 Auto-lend slot, each its own loan; measured at the first build, plus 10%

instant_borrow_1_skip_early.reason: instant borrow with one source skipped (refused early: no instant consent) before one fill; measured at the first build, plus 10%

instant_borrow_1_skip_late.reason: instant borrow with one source skipped (refused late: at loan creation) before one fill; measured at the first build, plus 10%

instant_borrow_2.reason: instant borrow taking 2 Auto-lend slots, each its own loan; measured at the first build, plus 10%; raised 2026-11-22 when prices moved from mocks onto the real guard path (#3915): each price read now runs the guard's own code

instant_borrow_4.reason: instant borrow taking 4 Auto-lend slots, each its own loan; measured at the first build, plus 10%; raised 2026-11-22 when prices moved from mocks onto the real guard path (#3915): each price read now runs the guard's own code

instant_borrow_8.reason: instant borrow taking 8 Auto-lend slots, each its own loan; measured at the first build, plus 10%; raised 2026-11-22 when prices moved from mocks onto the real guard path (#3915): each price read now runs the guard's own code

instruction_reserve_fund.reason: a loan reserve funded by the borrower; measured at the first build, plus 10%

instruction_run_due_repay.reason: a repayment at the due date run from the payment reserve; measured at the first build, plus 10%

instruction_run_interest.reason: an interest payment run from the payment reserve; measured at the first build, plus 10%

instruction_run_topup.reason: a collateral top-up run from the reserve when health falls under the trigger; measured at the first build, plus 10%; raised 2026-11-22 when prices moved from mocks onto the real guard path (#3915): each price read now runs the guard's own code

instruction_set.reason: standing instructions set on an open loan; measured at the first build, plus 10%

loan_accept_erc20.reason: an ERC-20 lender offer accepted: the loan opened, both tokens and the initiation fee; measured at the first build, plus 10%

loan_match_offers.reason: a lender and a borrower offer matched by a third party into one loan; measured at the first build, plus 10%

offer_cancel.reason: an open offer cancelled after the cancel delay, its token burned and assets released; measured at the first build, plus 10%

offer_change.reason: an open offer's amount changed by its creator; measured at the first build, plus 10%

offer_post.reason: a lender offer posted from the wallet, with its position token and book entry; measured at the first build, plus 10%

refinance_accept.reason: a refinance offer accepted: the old loan repaid and a new one opened; measured at the first build, plus 10%

rental_accept.reason: an NFT rental offer accepted, the renter set and the fee prepaid; measured at the first build, plus 10%

rental_day_deduct.reason: one day of an NFT rental fee deducted; measured at the first build, plus 10%

repay_full.reason: an open ERC-20 loan repaid in full by its borrower; measured at the first build, plus 10%

repay_partial.reason: part of an open ERC-20 loan repaid by its borrower; measured at the first build, plus 10%; raised 2026-11-22 when prices moved from mocks onto the real guard path (#3915): each price read now runs the guard's own code

slot_cancel.reason: an Auto-lend slot cancelled by its owner; measured at the first build, plus 10%

slot_fund.reason: an Auto-lend slot funded from the wallet; measured at the first build, plus 10%

slot_match.reason: a borrower offer filled from an Auto-lend slot by a keeper; measured at the first build, plus 10%

slot_set.reason: an Auto-lend slot set by its owner; measured at the first build, plus 10%; raised 2026-11-22 when prices moved from mocks onto the real guard path (#3915): each price read now runs the guard's own code

vault_deposit.reason: an ERC-20 deposit into the owner's vault; measured at the first build, plus 10%

vault_withdraw.reason: an ERC-20 withdrawal from the owner's vault to the wallet; measured at the first build, plus 10%

instantBorrow._guardReadBudgetWhy: Design re-ruling 2026-11-22 (instant borrow source cap): the gas the Diamond hands each guard read (LibPriceGuard GUARD_READ_GAS). Handed, not spent: unused gas comes back. The transaction must still hold it once for its last read, so the rule adds it once per transaction.

guardSourceCosts._why: Cold cost of one call to each outside source the mainnet guard reads, as a caller sees it, measured on live forks by test/fork/GuardSourceReadCostFork.t.sol on 2026-11-22. Each kind takes the dearest call measured for it. Re-measure when a source changes.

chainlinkFeed.where: Arbitrum One, Chainlink ETH/USD proxy latestRoundData (proxy plus aggregator, both cold)

feedRegistry.where: Base Sepolia feed registry pairBase; the Ethereum mainnet Chainlink registry getFeed measured 8,057

sequencer.where: Arbitrum One, Chainlink L2 sequencer uptime feed latestRoundData

dia.where: Arbitrum Sepolia, DIA getValue ETH/USD (DIA has no getValue oracle on Arbitrum One)

instantBorrow._skipAllowanceWhy: Design re-ruling 2026-11-22: until the one-price-per-asset-per-transaction root fix, a list may carry one source beyond the fill bound, counted at the dearest measured skip (a late skip at its own cost).

ethereum.why: EIP-7825 caps one transaction at 2^24 gas; the lowest cap among the Phase-1 networks recorded here. Add a network whose cap is lower.
